title: Validation evidence item
description: One piece of cited evidence behind a validation record (EE-026), shared by every validation sub-score. packages/naive/src/checks/check-validation.mjs grades each item from its kind, audience, sample, specificity and age (adapted from GRADE), and grades the record from its items. A claim with no evidence grades very low.

kind.description: behavior: what people did (retention, payments, repeat use, money or time already spent on workarounds); commitment: what they put at stake (deposit, pre-order, letter of intent, time booked); stated: what they said when asked (interview, survey); desk-research: published data or reports; opinion: unprompted praise, advice or compliments

summary.description: What the evidence shows, specific enough to check

supports.description: false when the evidence contradicts the claim

source.description: Where to see it: a URL with the date it was checked, or a file relative to the venture folder (interview notes, a data export), or both

audience.description: Whether the people behind it are the venture's target segment for this claim (for pricing, the buyer)

specificity.description: specific: past facts, numbers, named instances; general: hypotheticals, generalities, opinions about the future (The Mom Test)

assumption.description: Problem records only (EE-050): the assumption the item bears on. exists: the problem is real; segment: our segment has it; hurts: it costs enough that people already spend time or money on it; why-now: something has changed. Without it the item counts toward exists. packages/naive/src/engine/assess-problem.mjs labels each assumption from its items.

origin.description: first-hand: the venture saw it (its own interviews, payments, data exports); reported: someone else says so (a vendor's customer count, a report, a roundup). Defaults to first-hand for a file in the venture folder and reported for a URL. Only first-hand evidence can demonstrate an assumption (EE-050).

form.description: Problem records only (EE-050): the id of the form the item bears on. It counts for that form and for the root.
